summary: The diff implements both REQ-36 (English text conversion) and REQ-37 (white accent design) across all major components. All visible text is in English, white-card CSS classes are applied to service cards, FAQ items, feedback cards, HowItWorks step cards, ContactSection cards, and AboutSection cards. Brand accent colors #FFD700/#FF8C42 are preserved. Form inputs in ProfileModal and ScrollRatingPopup have white/light borders. However, some specific acceptance criteria need closer examination — notably section dividers between major sections and HowItWorksSection connector lines with white accents.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add white/light-tinted section dividers or subtle white borders between major sections (REQ-37 AC: Section background alternates or uses subtle white accents/borders to separate sections)
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows sections using bg-background and bg-surface-50 alternating, and border-y border-white/10 on TrustStatsBar, but no explicit white-tinted section divider elements are inserted between major sections in App.tsx or individual section components.

missing_requirements.requirement: HowItWorksSection connector lines between steps should use white/light accents (REQ-37 item 3)
missing_requirements.reason: The HowItWorksSection shows no connector line elements between the 3 step cards. The relative div wrapper is present but no horizontal connector line with white/light styling is implemented.
